title: DxfImportResult
description: What the import added and which texts were read from the DXF source.

matched.description: Texts matched to their DXF entity (layer and position) and stamped

rewritten.description: Texts whose stored string changed, as 'Rhino's text -> decoded text'

unmatched.description: Texts left as Rhino made them: no DXF entity on their layer within 1 mm, or two equally near

message.description: Imported office_2D.dxf: 283 objects. Texts 16/16 read from the DXF, 1 rewritten.
